q: The _____ universe is a topic of great interest for scientists.
translation: 不断膨胀的宇宙是科学家们非常感兴趣的话题。

q: The more we try to control nature, the more _____ we are that nature will answer our interference with violence.
explain: fearful adj. 害怕的，担心的。
translation: 我们越想控制自然，就越害怕自然会对我们的干涉报以暴力。

q: He was known as a powerful king and a _____ warrior.
explain: fearless adj. 无畏的，大胆的。
translation: 他作为一位强大的国王和一名无畏的战士而为人所知。

q: Technology stocks are _____ the rest of the market.
explain: outperform v. 表现优于，胜过。
translation: 科技股的表现优于市场其他板块。

q: They hope to _____ the neighborhood by providing better housing.
explain: revitalize v. 使恢复活力，振兴。
translation: 他们希望通过提供更好的住房来振兴这个街区。

q: He prides himself on the _____ of the company.
translation: 他为公司长久的历史感到自豪。

q: There was a _____ change in his mood after the meeting.
explain: visible adj. 显著的，明显的。
translation: 会议之后，他的情绪有了明显的变化。

q: This election has profound _____ for the future of American democracy.
explain: implication n. 可能的影响，含义。
translation: 这次选举对美国民主的未来有着深远的影响。

q: Do they have any evidence to _____ him in the robbery?
explain: implicate v. 牵连，表明与（犯罪或坏事）有关。
translation: 他们有证据表明他与这起抢劫案有关吗？

q: The bank will need full _____ of your financial situation and assets.
translation: 银行将需要你全面披露你的财务状况和资产。

q: Several military bases are now threatened with permanent _____.
translation: 好几处军事基地现在面临永久关闭的威胁。

q: Several companies have _____ profits of over two hundred million pounds.
translation: 几家公司已经披露了超过两亿英镑的利润。

q: He had always been _____ by his elder sister.
explain: overshadow v. 使黯然失色，使显得不那么重要。
translation: 与姐姐相比，他总是黯然失色。

q: Our staff will be available to give you _____ support.
explain: technical adj. 技术的，技术性的。
translation: 我们的员工将随时为你提供技术支持。

q: This is a new synthesis _____ that can generate sounds from slow movements of mechanical systems.
explain: technique n. 技术，方法，技巧。
translation: 这是一种新的合成技术，可以从机械系统的缓慢运动中产生声音。

q: This _____ enables computers to read handwriting more accurately.
translation: 这项技术使电脑能够更准确地读取手写内容。

q: The stores have to _____ for customers in the Christmas season.
translation: 圣诞节期间，商店之间必须争抢顾客。

q: There is a lot of _____ between computer companies.
translation: 计算机公司之间的竞争非常激烈。

q: The bank isn't performing as well as some of its _____.
translation: 这家银行的表现不如它的一些竞争对手。

q: The market offers a _____ of foods from different countries.
translation: 这个市场提供来自不同国家的多种食物。

q: Home _____ has become more difficult for young people.
translation: 对年轻人来说，拥有住房变得更加困难。

q: She _____ in a small coffee shop near her home.
translation: 她投资了家附近的一家小咖啡店。

q: The patient showed steady _____ after the operation.
translation: 病人在手术后表现出稳定的康复。

q: The teacher drew a straight _____ across the blackboard.
translation: 老师在黑板上画了一条直线。

q: The new rules _____ up with the needs of local farmers.
explain: line v. 与……一致；排成一行（line up with）。
translation: 新规定与当地农民的需求一致。

q: We waited for the _____ of the film before leaving.
translation: 我们等到电影结束才离开。

q: He studied hard and _____ up winning the prize.
explain: end v. 最终成为，结果是（end up）。
translation: 他努力学习，最终赢得了奖项。

q: Run faster or you will not _____ up with the team.
explain: catch v. 赶上，追上（catch up）。
translation: 跑快点，否则你赶不上队伍。

q: The fisherman brought home a good _____ of fish.
translation: 渔夫带回家不少捕获的鱼。

q: The workers cut _____ to finish the building on time.
explain: corner n. 角落（cut corners：偷工减料）。
translation: 工人们为了按时完工而偷工减料。

q: The police _____ the thief in a small alley.
translation: 警察把小偷逼进了一条小巷。

q: They decided to pull the _____ on the old machine.
explain: plug n. 插头；塞子（pull the plug：终止）。
translation: 他们决定停止使用那台旧机器。

q: She _____ her phone into the charger before bed.
explain: plug v. 插入，接上电源。
translation: 她睡前把手机插上充电器。

q: After two hours of running, I hit the _____.
explain: wall n. 墙（hit the wall：精疲力竭）。
translation: 跑了两小时后，我精疲力竭了。

q: The garden was _____ to keep animals out.
translation: 花园被墙围住，以防动物进入。

q: Learning a new language is a big _____ for me.
translation: 学习一门新语言对我来说是个很大的挑战。

q: The coach _____ the players to try harder.

translation: 教练激励队员们更加努力。

q: We _____ around a few ideas before the meeting.
explain: kick v. 随意讨论（kick around）。
translation: 开会前我们随意讨论了一些想法。

q: He gave the ball a strong _____ with his right foot.
translation: 他用右脚狠狠踢了球一下。

q: The rain _____ us from going out for a walk.
translation: 下雨使我们不敢出去散步。

q: The manager put his _____ at the bottom of the letter.
translation: 经理在信末签了名。

q: This is the chef's _____ dish at the restaurant.
explain: signature adj. 标志性的，招牌的。
translation: 这是这家餐厅厨师的招牌菜。

q: We walked along a _____ path beside the river.
explain: winding adj. 蜿蜒的，曲折的。
translation: 我们沿着河边一条蜿蜒的小路行走。

q: The _____ of the old clock needs to be done carefully.
translation: 给这座旧钟上发条需要小心进行。

q: The _____ blew the leaves across the empty street.

translation: 那条狭窄的路蜿蜒穿过山丘通向村庄。

q: Many students pass without any real _____ in learning.

translation: 起初很难让学生参与进来。

q: There has been a big increase in _____ between East and West.

q: The boy _____ his skates for a cricket bat.
translation: 男孩用他的溜冰鞋换了一个板球拍。

q: The rubber band was _____ too far and broke.

q: She used to read for hours at a _____.
explain: stretch n. 连续的一段时间。
translation: 她过去常常连续阅读好几个小时。

q: A crisis has _____ in the Foreign Office.

q: This is a _____ way to fight crime.

translation: 这是一种具有成本效益的打击犯罪的方式。

q: Working from home can be a _____ way to finish tasks.
explain: time-effective adj. 省时的；时间效率高的。
translation: 在家工作可能是完成任务的省时方式。

q: She was invited to take part in a poetry _____ on campus.
explain: workshop n. 研讨会；工作坊。
translation: 她受邀参加校园里的诗歌工作坊。

q: A fund was set up for the _____ of historic buildings.

q: Troops were sent to the area to _____ order.

q: She is still quite _____ to the job and needs help.
explain: new adj. 新来的；不熟悉的（new to sth.）。

q: The new law will come into _____ on the first of July next year.

q: Falling birth rates may _____ the trend towards early retirement.

q: Successful companies must be _____ and adaptable when the market changes.

translation: 成功的公司必须在市场变化时保持灵活和适应性。

q: The curriculum was too narrow and too _____ for most students.
explain: rigid adj. 僵硬的，死板的。
translation: 对大多数学生来说，这套课程太狭窄、太死板了。

translation: 新系统在工作安排方式上提供了更大的灵活性。

q: The clay shows remarkable _____ and can be shaped into almost any form.

q: Two thirds of the region has been _____ in the past decade.
explain: deforest v. 砍伐森林，毁林。
translation: 该地区三分之二的森林在过去十年中被砍伐殆尽。

q: The technician _____ the alarm system before the repairs began.
translation: 技术员在维修开始前关闭了警报系统。

q: My shoes have _____ down at the heel after months of daily use.
explain: wear v. 磨损；使疲惫（wear down）。
translation: 这双鞋每天穿了好几个月，后跟已经磨平了。

q: You need to _____ in mind that the deadline is next Friday.
explain: bear v. 记住，考虑（bear in mind）。
translation: 你需要记住截止日期是下周五。

q: The event had been planned with _____ attention to detail.
explain: painstaking adj. 费尽心思的，一丝不苟的。
translation: 这次活动是经过一丝不苟的细节关注才策划出来的。

q: She writes _____ articles for various academic publications.
explain: scholarly adj. 学术的；博学的。
translation: 她为各种学术出版物撰写学术文章。

q: He was the most distinguished _____ in his field.
translation: 他是他所在领域最杰出的学者。

q: The bar is great and the staff are _____ to every guest.
explain: friendly adj. 友好的，友善的。
translation: 这家酒吧很棒，员工对每位客人都很友好。

q: A nasty incident was prevented by the _____ arrival of the police.
explain: timely adj. 及时的，适时的。
translation: 警察的及时赶到阻止了一起恶性事件。

q: The plates were in _____ stacks according to size and color.

translation: 盘子按大小和颜色整齐地叠放着。

explain: costly adj. 昂贵的；代价高的。
translation: 对一个小家庭来说，买新家具可能太贵了。

q: Public pressure eventually _____ a change in the government's position.

q: The curtain _____ to reveal an empty stage.

q: The _____ in food prices worried many families.

q: The government plans to _____ taxes next year.

q: This _____ shows films about wild animals every Sunday.

q: They live in a _____ room with a small kitchen.

translation: 他们住在一个带小厨房的单间里。

translation: 他被选为运动会上表现最好的人。

q: In _____ of the new evidence, the museum revised the object's date.
explain: light n. 光；在 in light of 中表示鉴于，考虑到。

q: This bag is _____ enough to carry all day.
translation: 这个包很轻，可以背一整天。

q: She _____ a candle and placed it on the table.

translation: 大多数市议员投票支持新公园提案。

q: The teacher tends to _____ students who ask questions.

q: With this new album he has _____ his musical roots.

translation: 通过这张新专辑，他重新找到了自己的音乐根源。

q: We have the _____ to help you run your business.

translation: 我们拥有帮助你经营业务的专业知识。

q: The new map makes the old town more _____.

translation: 新地图使老城区对游客更加友好。

translation: 我们能做些什么让博物馆更方便游客使用呢？

explain: family-friendly adj. 适合家庭的，对家庭友好的。
translation: 我将重点关注家庭友好型政策和弹性工作制。

q: _____ helps pay for rainforest protection in many tropical countries.
translation: 生态旅游帮助许多热带国家支付雨林保护的费用。
